source.snippet: I want to perform bulk migration of Quip documents through the API. When using the Automation API and Admin API, I frequently encounter rate limit issues. Is it possible to remove the hourly rate limit and only keep the per-minute rate limit?

problem_statement: Organizations migrating large Quip document libraries via the API are repeatedly blocked by rate limits, making bulk migration projects impractically slow or requiring manual workarounds.
target_segment: Salesforce admins and IT/ops teams at companies needing to migrate or archive Quip document collections at scale.
notes: Single signal (2026-09-14) but clearly in a paid enterprise context — Quip is a Salesforce-licensed product. Bulk document migration is a recurring need as companies onboard/offboard from Quip. Opportunity: a managed migration service or smart rate-limit-aware batching tool for Quip API exports. Buyers are IT admins or consultants billing time on migration projects — clear willingness to pay for time saved.
